searchText: What do you mean by "data contracts" exactly? Contracts which basically just store data, a la sstore2 EVMMAX just adds some instructions? Yes. OK. So should be quite easy to add them into geas then It depends on desing but in current spec only instructions yul? Yes, yul would be good. But do we need to fork it to make extensions? We just need to extend EVMDialect in solidity. it's quite straightforward but there is no support for plugin-like system for yul. Or we can just implement new Dialect which extends https://github.com/ethereum/solidity/blob/develop/libyul/backends/evm/EVMDialect.h And change here https://github.com/ethereum/solidity/blob/develop/libevmasm/Assembly.h But it's well separated fragment of solidity code base. People also write ecc related functions in yul already. If I get the time I'd like to write a standard data contract interface for osaka-devnet-0, to show what it looks like. Could also add to vyper- it should be fairly easy to add to the frontend as well Same. I think we can replicate the Sstore2 interface.
